acceptanceCriteria: The three Core jobs are VERIFIED and every other job is visibly UNPROVEN or companion-profiled.
Core profiles have tested N-1 compatibility, the frozen wire's canonical vectors and in-repo second consumer pass with no interoperability claim, and current platform or host evidence.
The candidate-bound stable-readiness record, proof maps and independent review bind one immutable commit, tree and artifact set without circular publication or promotion prerequisites.
The owner explicitly accepts stable promotion and publication, and the post-action release record observes the resulting tag, publication and promotion identities.
body:
Promote Corvint 1.0 only from the qualified release-candidate packet. This ticket authorizes no automatic tag, publication or deployment.

2026-09-29 owner policy accepted for both 1.0.0-rc.2 and 1.0.0: no signing; verified SHA256SUMS and retained reproducibility evidence; publisher identity NOT_VERIFIED; latest non-withdrawn stable artifact set supported until its next stable successor, prereleases do not retire stable, withdrawals immediate, existing seven-day acknowledgement target and no fix-time SLA. Decision 0428 committed in isolated integration at 96a69bbd. This is policy selection only; exact candidate qualification, publication and stable promotion approvals remain outstanding.
title: Accept and promote Corvint 1.0 stable
